catalog_quote: 3.3.2.4. Penultimate stress norm [heading]. Almost all bisyllabic words in Manarayi are stressed on the penultimate syllable, no matter what their constituency ... 3.3.2.5. Stress in polysyllabic nominal roots [heading]. Stress in trisyllabic unreduplicated nominal roots is predominantly on the penultimate syllable, expecially [sic] if this syllable is closed. However, there are many ... trisyllabic roots in which word stress is on the first syllable, and a few in which stress may variably occur on the first or the penultimate syllable. Those in which stress usually occurs on the first syllable generally have open penultimate syllable, but exceptions to this are found. Examples of the two patterns, first and penultimate syllable stress, are: ... waláyjnin 'shade, shadow' ... wánulu 'good-for-nothing' ... Quadrisyllabic unreduplicative nominal roots also show two major stress patterns. I…
